resources.string: In the order the MODE / SRC key goes through them. Off: skipped.
Activate after %1$d s without a key
Otherwise it plays in the background when it can (notification access).
Start the last source at boot
Notification access lets EasySource pause the other sources and start one without opening it.

In LibreHU Touches, set the MODE / SRC key to \"Open an app\" → EasySource (source picker). Each press shows the next source; it starts after the delay above, or at once with OK / play. ▶▶ / ◀◀ move in the list too. Other apps can start the picker:
MODE / ▶▶ : next · ◀◀ : previous · starts in %1$d s
